questions: Did your leg injury occur suddenly, such as after a fall or road-traffic accident?
Did you hear or feel a snap when the injury occurred?
Is your main pain in the thigh?
Is the pain mainly around your hip or groin?
Is the pain mainly below your knee?
Have you been unable to stand or bear weight on that leg since the injury?
Did the injured leg appear shortened, bent, or rotated abnormally?
Is there an open wound near the injured leg?
Did you lose consciousness or sustain a head injury?
Do you have neck or back pain?
Do you have numbness or tingling in the injured leg or foot?
Do you have weakness or inability to move your foot or toes?
Has the foot become unusually cold, pale, or bluish?
Have you had increasing swelling or pain despite the traction?
Have you had fever or chills since the injury?
Have you had any previous fracture or surgery involving this leg?
